_comment: Issue #2010, epic #1977 work package F: the coding-plan shape, first
provider. The billing provider is 'zai'; no coding-agent adapter has
that name. Z.ai is reached through Claude Code with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL,
and the transcript then still names the requested Claude model, so the
quota binds to a session only by an observed route to api.z.ai — never
by adapter or model. The pseudo-adapter holding the consent row is
The coding plan is a separate product from Z.ai's general API
(/api/paas/v4, prepaid bundles). Nothing here reads that product. China
region (open.bigmodel.cn) and team scope are not covered.

credential_resolvers.location: the Claude Code settings file that set the session's observed api.z.ai route: env.ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, else env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, read only while that file still names api.z.ai

redaction.note: The raw body carries code, msg, success and data; msg ("Operation successful") is dropped. Inside data only level and each limit's type, unit, number, usage, currentValue, remaining, percentage and nextResetTime are kept. The probe's bodies carried no account data.

fixtures.name: quota-limit-nothing-used
fixtures.note: 13:12:58Z, before any use: the five-hour window has no nextResetTime.

fixtures.name: quota-limit-after-run
fixtures.note: 13:16:20Z, after one 2-turn Claude Code run: 2 used of 2000, remaining 1997.

fixtures.name: quota-limit-after-routes
fixtures.note: 13:20:20Z, after probe rows A and B: 11 used of 2000, remaining 1988.

billing_mode.note: data.level ("lite") names the coding-plan tier, the only product identifier in the response; the key was created on the coding-plan page. A response with no level is not presented as the plan.

quota_windows.note: Two CREDIT_LIMIT windows, measured in credits: unit 3 number 5 (five hours, reset five hours after first use, absent before it) and unit 6 number 1 (one week, reset seven days after the subscription began). usage is the limit and currentValue the amount used; remaining is not usage minus currentValue and is taken as reported; percentage is an integer that rounds up.

balance.note: Z.ai's general API prepaid bundles (/api/paas/v4) were not probed; the coding-plan key was not used against it.

account_identity.note: The response carries no account identifier, so BuildSnapshot leaves ConfirmedAccountRef empty. The poll is keyed by a salted, in-memory fingerprint of the key: #1977 §3.2's credential identity, not an account identity. Two sessions on one key share a reading; two keys never do, even on one account.

evidence.note: Three responses from GET https://api.z.ai/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit on the GLM Coding Lite-V3 plan, redacted before they were written; recorded on issue #2010 (comment 7063374830).
The allowlist decode, and BuildSnapshot leaving ConfirmedAccountRef empty.
